messages:
jordan: FYI link-scan found a dead cross-ref in docs/onboarding/getting-started.md -> points to /docs/runtime/kv-cache which 404s. Can someone fix before next release?
docs-bot: [alert] broken-link detected: /docs/runtime/kv-cache (scan 2025-07-02)
sam: I can do a quick patch. Should we change to /docs/runtime/kv-cache/guide or add a redirect?
taylor: The page was moved in PR #8300 to /docs/runtime/kv-cache/guide. Easiest is to update the cross-ref and add a changelog line.
sam: Plan: 1) update the link to `/docs/runtime/kv-cache/guide` 2) run `mkdocs build` + `tools/link-checker` 3) add CHANGELOG entry and open PR.
jordan: Also add yourself as owner in OWNERS.yaml for onboarding/getting-started.md while you're at it.
sam: Will do. Local smoke command: `mkdocs build && tools/link-checker --site-dir site`
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8610 — title "docs: onboarding cross-ref -> kv-cache guide". Marked smallfix and added changelog.
taylor: Quick review incoming. Nit: prefer relative path without leading domain and include a 1-line note in the doc about the move so search results show context.
docs-bot: Deploy preview ready: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/8610 — link-checker passed, page returns 200.
jordan: LGTM after CI green. Thanks everyone :tada:
